summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Customers admin page (Add/Edit/Delete/Search/Type badges/Validation). All primary flows pass end-to-end with persistence verified via GET.
critical_code_review_comments: Modal backdrop onClick={onClose} triggers close on any outside click even during save-in-flight (guarded only for the X button). Consider blocking backdrop close while saving.
Delete uses window.confirm which is functional but a shadcn/AlertDialog would be more consistent with the design system.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TESTCust_Jane / TESTCust_JaneUpdated / TESTCust_APIJohn during test; cleanup step removes all TESTCust_* records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customers CRUD verified. Backend endpoints /api/customers (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) all 401 without bearer and 200 with admin. Frontend page /admin/customers has data-testid: customer-add-btn, customer-search, customer-modal, customer-name, customer-email, customer-phone, customer-type, customer-company, customer-notes, customer-save, cust-row-<id>, customer-edit-<id>, customer-delete-<id>. Type badges: buyer=bg-blue-100, seller=bg-emerald-100, tenant=bg-purple-100, landlord=bg-amber-100, corporate=bg-pine-500. Save button disabled when name blank. Pre-existing regression failures in test_page_content (team list), test_locations (province backfill, suburb idempotent), test_map_coords (property coords) are unrelated to this change and existed in prior iterations.
verified_flows: Navigate to /admin/customers (heading, add btn, search present)
ADD customer: modal opens 'New customer', save disabled on empty name, save enabled after name, submit persists (row appears + GET returns record)
EDIT customer: pencil opens modal 'Edit customer' with prefill, updates persist (row updated + verified)
DELETE customer: window.confirm auto-accepted, row disappears, not in GET list
VALIDATION: empty name -> save disabled; Cancel closes modal
TYPE BADGE: seller renders bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800
Backend 401 for unauthenticated POST/PUT/DELETE; admin bearer round-trip full CRUD
